_comment: Chapter G validation cases. Every case must carry a 'source' field --
Two kinds of source appear here:
'AISC Manual Table 3-2'  -- a published tabulated value.
'User Note G2.1, p. 16.1-71' -- the Specification's own list of ASTM A6
shapes that do NOT meet Sect. G2.1(a) at Fy = 50 ksi. Testing against
it is testing against the Specification itself.
'derived; cross-checked' -- hand-derived and confirmed bit-for-bit against
(23 W-shapes, relative difference 0.0e+00). A regression lock, and
labelled as such rather than passed off as a Manual value.
Each case: id, source, section (canonical names), grade, h_over_tw,

cases.note: Manual prints 192 kips; Sect. G2.1(a) applies so phi_v = 1.00.
